name: Transcribe Google video ads from the Ads Transparency Center to Google Sheets with Apify

parameters.content:
# Transcribe Google video ads from the Ads Transparency Center to Google Sheets with Apify

Take one advertiser or domain from Google's Ads Transparency Center and get their video ads as text: the first-3-seconds hook, full transcript, length, language and video URL, one row per ad.

### Who it's for
YouTube and Google Ads media buyers who want to read competitor video scripts at volume instead of watching them one by one.

### How it works
1. A Set node holds the Transparency Center URL (an advertiser or a domain) and the number of ads to fetch.
2. An HTTP Request starts the Google Ads Transparency scraper on Apify, then an If node and a polling request wait until the run finishes.
3. The run's dataset ID is handed to the Google Ads Video Transcript Scraper on Apify, so no ad rows pass through n8n. Each video ad is transcribed and the hook extracted. Videos with no speech come back as uncharged misses.
4. A Code node shapes one row per ad, a Set node tidies the columns and a Google Sheets node appends them.

### Setup
1. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential (name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`) and select it on the three HTTP Request nodes.
2. Connect Google Sheets and pick the spreadsheet and sheet.
3. Open the Config node, set the Transparency Center URL and how many ads to process.
4. Run the workflow.

### Requirements
An Apify account and a Google account.

### Customization tips
Point it at a domain to cover every advertiser behind it. Keep the video_url column to review the creative. Add a Schedule Trigger to track an advertiser weekly.

## 1. Configure
Your input URL and item count live in one Set node.

## 2. Scrape and wait
Start the Apify scraper run, then poll it every few seconds until it finishes.

## 3. Transcribe and shape rows
Hand the run's dataset ID to the transcript actor, then build one row per item.

## 4. Save
Append the rows to Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: transparencyCenterUrl = a Google Ads Transparency Center URL with an advertiser or domain selected — open https://adstransparency.google.com/, pick the advertiser (or type a domain), set region/date, and copy the address bar. Advertiser form: https://adstransparency.google.com/advertiser/AR…?region=US. maxAds = how many ads to pull (image/text ads included — only the video ones are transcribed).

nodes.name: Scrape the Transparency Center (advertiser)
nodes.notes: Starts silva95gustavo/google-ads-scraper and waits up to 60s. Returns the run object — we only need data.defaultDatasetId. To use another Transparency Center scraper, swap the actor slug + the JSON body to its input fields.

nodes.name: Wait for scrape (poll run)
nodes.notes: Loops back until the scraper run finishes (each poll waits up to 60s server-side).

nodes.name: Transcribe video ads by dataset ID: hooks & transcripts
nodes.notes: Chains steadyfetch/google-ads-video-transcript-scraper on the scraper run's dataset ID (no ad rows pass through n8n, so big batches stay light). One row per video ad: transcript + first-3s hook + advertiser metadata; rows without a video come back as uncharged no_creative_found. Charged only when a transcript is delivered.

nodes.name: Teardown table (one row per item)
nodes.notes: Terminal step: a clean spreadsheet-shaped row per ad. Wire Google Sheets / Airtable / Slack / a database after this node.
